fact: A Ministry of Health and Public Hygiene mission of 17-22 August 2026 reported that the OpenClinic hospital information system, deployed in five health facilities of Mamou and Dalaba (Dalaba prefectural hospital from January 2026) with Enabel's SAFE project, offers interoperability with the national DHIS2, while paper reporting to the SNIS continues in parallel.

A workshop of 25-28 November 2025 in Conakry, run by Terre des Hommes with the Ministry of Health and Public Hygiene and funded by Enabel via Wehubit, transferred skills on interoperability of health information systems, with a consultant mapping the sector's digital tools and aggregated individual data to feed the SNIS.
